fields.description: Identifies the role of this site so Processa can behave appropriately per environment. "Review Doctypes/Workflow" is available only on a BA instance; "Reassign User Task" only on a Production instance.
fields.label: Instance Type

fields.description: If checked, a Process Implementation with "Active" status in Production is required to make changes to a process map.
fields.label: Connect to Production

fields.description: Personal (or fine-grained) access token able to push branches and open pull requests. Used by "Review Doctypes" → "Sync" to raise a PR with the DocType schema changes. The repository is derived from each referenced DocType's owning app (its git remote), and the PR targets that repository's default branch.
fields.label: GitHub Access Token

fields.options: Controls the pre-deployment security gate for BPMN Script Tasks. Dangerous escape vectors (exec/eval/getattr, frame-walking dunders, permission-bypass kwargs, memory bombs, destructive SQL) are always blocked and are not configurable here. The options below tighten the gate for constructs that also have legitimate uses; all default to allowed.

fields.description: Reject multiplication whose factor exceeds this value (memory-bomb guard, e.g. "A" * 999999999). Leave at 50000 unless you have a reason to change it.
fields.label: Multiplication Factor Threshold

fields.description: Block while loops in script tasks (use a BPMN gateway/loop instead).
fields.label: Block while Loops

fields.description: Block function definitions (def / async def) in script tasks.
fields.label: Block Function Definitions

fields.description: Also block the commonly-legitimate builtins hasattr / type / id / classmethod / staticmethod.
fields.label: Strict Builtins

fields.description: Also block the sensitive Frappe attributes sql / commit / flags / conf / cache (destructive raw SQL is always blocked regardless).
fields.label: Strict Frappe Attributes

fields.description: Block ALL imports, not just the dangerous-module denylist.
fields.label: Block All Imports

fields.description: Who may release a frozen conversation. Site-wide because it is a statement about roles here, not about any one agent. The thresholds that DECIDE a freeze, and the message throttle, live on each AI Agent Configuration.
fields.label: AI Conversation Freeze

fields.description: Comma-separated roles allowed to release a frozen conversation. System Manager is always allowed. The locked user can never release their own conversation, whatever roles they hold.
Site-wide defaults for the models that write long-term memory. An agent's own Memory Models override these; with both blank, memory writes use the agent's own AI Model, exactly as before.
fields.label: AI Memory

fields.description: Used when an agent has no Distillation Model of its own.
fields.label: Default Distillation Model

fields.description: Used when an agent has no Reconciliation Model of its own. Tune here to fix poor reconciliations across every agent at once.
fields.label: Default Reconciliation Model
